experiment: R-TM-01 - Tsetlin machine as escalation decision layer

sweep.selection: val accuracy on a 1500-row slice of TRAIN, tie-break val ECE

hidden_rule_terms: R2: any gate fails AND reviewer_verdict == accept
R3: cross_domain_quantity_changed AND interface_node_touched AND reviewer_verdict == uncertain
R4: reviewer_verdict == reject AND reviewer_confidence == high AND prior_failures_module >= 2
R5: NOT gate_propagation_pass AND domain in {elec, ctrl}

arms.RULE: ASSUMED current rule: escalate if attempt==3 OR any gate fails (the source spec does not print ARCH-030/040's rule)

confidence.TM: p = clip(0.5*(1+clip(v,-T,T)/T),0,1), v = class-1 clause sum
confidence.temperature_scaled: p = sigmoid(v/(T*temp)), temp fitted by NLL on a 500-row slice of TRAIN

environment.note: tmu 0.8.3 patched for numpy>=2: np.uint32(~0) -> np.uint32(0xFFFFFFFF) in clause_bank/clause_bank.py:136,145 and clause_bank_cuda.py:169; tmu hangs when its internal seed is 0, so TM seeds are 1000+seed

corrections_after_code_audit: clause decoding restricted to the positive-polarity bank (indices 0..n/2-1)
clause ranking moved from Test-ID to TRAIN, using the noiseless rule label
distinct clause bodies only (tmu banks hold many duplicate clauses)
A1 accuracy read from the TM's argmax decision, not the 0.5 threshold on p
one-parameter temperature scaling as the S3 variant; 2-parameter Platt reported beside it
no-fw arm is the train/Test-ID draws with fw rows removed, per S2's wording
